papers.title: Noise Space Learning for VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models encode broad manipulation priors, yet adapting them to specific tasks requires balancing limited robot interaction, computational resources, and safety constraints. Noise space learning (NSL) adapts flow-matching-based VLAs by learning a context-conditioned distribution over noise while keeping the pretrained VLA fixed. Building on prior noise-steering methods, we formulate NSL as an interface for VLA adaptation that accommodates different learning algorithms and instantiate it with PPO, SAC, and AWR. Theoretically, we provide an information-theoretic analysis of how NSL enables efficient adaptation. Empirically, we study these NSL algorithms on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot manipulation tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints. Across these settings, we develop a suite of effective NSL variants and derive practical recommendations for choosing among them under different resource and deployment regimes.

ai_summary.problem: 预训练VLA模型虽然具备通用操作先验，但在特定任务适配时需在有限机器人交互、计算资源和安全约束之间取得平衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出噪声空间学习（NSL），在固定预训练流匹配VLA的前提下，学习一个上下文条件化的噪声分布，并将PPO、SAC、AWR等强化学习算法统一用于该适配接口。
ai_summary.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin及四个真实机器人操作任务中验证了多种NSL变体的有效性，并给出了不同资源与部署条件下的选择建议。
ai_summary.novelty: 将流匹配VLA的噪声空间作为适配接口，兼容多种学习算法，并从信息论角度分析其高效适配机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA模型在真实机器人任务中的低成本、安全、高效适配提供了新范式和实践指导。

papers.title: Images Talk Back: Guiding MMDiTs by Suppressing Image-to-Text Feedback
papers.abstract: Multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs) allow the evolving image to update internal text representations through joint attention. These representations then guide subsequent image updates, raising a question: does this feedback help correct deviations from the prompt, or preserve them? We find that image-to-text (I2T) feedback can preserve the objects and attributes already represented in the evolving image, including errors. Transplanting I2T messages can rescue failures or disrupt successes. At matched intervention strengths, suppressing the influence of I2T feedback improves generation, whereas opposite controls degrade it. These findings motivate Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG), which suppresses the influence of I2T feedback by guiding away from an auxiliary branch that strengthens this feedback and weakens text-to-image conditioning. The in-place variant, iSFG, directly suppresses I2T feedback and strengthens text-to-image conditioning, requiring no extra model evaluations. Temporal interventions motivate running the SFG branch during the first 20% of image sampling steps, requiring about $1.2\times$ the base NFE without classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments across three image-generation backbones show gains in alignment and preference-model scores. On FLUX, adding SFG to CFG raises GenEval from $0.6661$ to $0.7479$; on SD3.5M, iSFG adds $+1.33$ HPSv2.1 over CFG at zero extra NFE. The control also transfers to text-to-video and image-to-video generation, improving VBench scores. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）中，演化图像会通过联合注意力更新文本表示，进而影响后续图像生成；论文要探究这种图像到文本（I2T）反馈到底有助于纠正提示偏差，还是会保留已有错误。
ai_summary.method: 作者通过干预实验发现I2T反馈会保留图像中已存在的物体和属性（包括错误），并提出语义反馈引导（SFG）：通过远离一个强化I2T反馈并弱化文到图条件的辅助分支来抑制I2T反馈；原地版本iSFG直接抑制I2T并增强文到图条件，无需额外模型评估。SFG分支仅在图像采样前20%步骤运行。
ai_summary.result: 在三个图像生成骨干上，SFG/iSFG提升了提示对齐和偏好模型分数：FLUX上CFG+SFG将GenEval从0.6661提升到0.7479；SD3.5M上iSFG在零额外NFE下比CFG提升+1.33 HPSv2.1；方法还可迁移到文生视频和图生视频，提升VBench分数。
ai_summary.novelty: 揭示了MMDiT中I2T反馈会固化图像中的错误，并提出无需额外评估或极少额外计算即可抑制该反馈的引导方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态扩散模型的理解与可控生成提供了新机制洞察和实用改进，并可推广到视频生成任务。
ai_summary.org: 斯坦福大学（推测，Serena Yeung-Levy等）

papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

ai_summary.problem: 递归自我改进（RSI）希望将交互经验转化为持续能力提升，但外部反馈成本高，且随着策略演化，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。
ai_summary.method: 提出领域通用的 RSI-Anything 框架，基于 JEPA-Anything，用预测式世界模型指导动作与学习数据选择；观测反馈驱动策略/工作流改进和条件式世界模型适配，并通过组件与兼容性检查决定是否保留更新后的策略-模型对。
ai_summary.result: 在多个计算与科学领域取得显著增益：代码修复成功率从 26.3% 提升到 31.2%，GUI 任务完成率更高且平均动作数减少 39.4%，实验室规划分数从 21.80% 提升到 46.01%，反应优化在相同预算下达到 96.15% 平均最佳产率，优于贝叶斯优化的 82.16%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预测式世界模型、策略/工作流更新与更新保留检查结合，形成一个可跨领域实现递归自我改进的通用框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明世界模型与可保留的系统更新能降低反馈依赖，并在多样环境中实现持续自我改进，对世界模型、Agent 和自主进化系统研究有推动作用。

papers.title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
papers.abstract: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $\mathcal{O}(M+N)$ time. This combination - an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost - is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.

ai_summary.problem: 现代视觉和语言模型处理的长 token 序列成本很高，而现有 token 压缩方法在丢弃信息与依赖高代价成对匹配/全交互合并之间难以兼顾。
ai_summary.method: 提出 LapMerge，一种面向有序序列的可微 token 合并算子：用学习到的质量分布和 Laplace 核密度将序列划分为恰好 N 个等质量段，再通过前缀/后缀扫描聚合各段，使前向与反向均为 O(M+N)。
ai_summary.result: 在视觉和视觉语言任务中，LapMerge 匹配或优于强 token 压缩器，并在长序列上最高快两个数量级；当 token 顺序体现场景或时间局部性时尤其有效。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在有序序列 token 合并中同时实现精确输出预算、端到端可微和线性时间复杂度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长序列视觉/语言模型提供高效、可微且可控预算的 token 压缩模块，有助于降低下游计算成本并融入模型架构设计。
ai_summary.org: Jagiellonian University（雅盖隆大学，依据作者背景推断）

papers.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

ai_summary.problem: 当前大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）缺乏主动空间心理化（ASM）能力，即无法像人类一样主动从任务相关视角重新观察场景并重构空间布局，导致复杂空间推理能力不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SpatialASM 框架，通过训练时的空间模拟将主动空间心理化内化到 LVLMs 中。该方法使用异中心新视角生成器将假设视角锚定到视觉证据，并构造两类监督：显式 ASM 轨迹和自动生成的视角采择任务。
ai_summary.result: 在七个空间基准上，SpatialASM 在四种 LVLM 骨干上均提升了空间推理平均准确率，同时保留原有通用视觉能力，并为缓解空间 CoT 监督稀缺提供了可扩展路径。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出并系统性地将主动空间心理化能力通过训练时空间模拟内化到 LVLMs，结合显式 ASM 轨迹与自动视角采择任务来激发主动视角探索和心理场景模拟。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动 LVLMs 从被动感知走向主动空间推理，为世界模型、具身智能和多模态空间智能提供可扩展的监督与训练范式。

papers.title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
papers.abstract: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.

ai_summary.problem: 驾驶世界动作模型（WAM）通过强化学习后训练可以探索替代轨迹，但驾驶日志只包含实际记录轨迹的未来视频，导致这些替代轨迹缺乏对应的视觉监督。
ai_summary.method: SimVTA 是一个基于仿真的后训练框架：先为每个观测采样候选轨迹，并用真实世界模拟器（如 World Engine）在 3DGS 重建场景中为高奖励候选渲染未来视频；在有限渲染预算下优先监督高误差未来，再结合 GRPO 优化轨迹规划，并用匹配视频上的 flow-matching 损失更新共享表征。
ai_summary.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上，将 SimVTA 应用于 WAM 初始化可将 PDMS 从 86.2 提升到 91.3（+5.1）；在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 88.2 EPDMS，在 HUGSIM 闭环评估中平均 HD-Score 为 38.8。消融实验表明，用视频监督更新共享表征可提升规划，优先监督高奖励轨迹中的高误差未来还能进一步提升性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将仿真渲染的轨迹匹配视频监督与强化学习轨迹优化结合，为驾驶 WAM 的替代轨迹提供独立于模型自身预测的视觉监督，并更新共享表征。
ai_summary.relevance: 为驾驶世界动作模型的可扩展后训练提供了新思路，使反事实轨迹也能获得视觉监督，从而同时提升规划性能与世界模型表征。

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.abstract: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于概念的归因方法通常只能解释分类和回归模型，且需要模型权重或大量概念标注数据，多数无法提供图像级归因。本文旨在为黑盒视觉模型提供无需权重和概念标注数据集的概念级归因。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Hide and Seek（HnS）：给定概念和图像集，先用视觉语言模型检索与概念对齐的图像，并在每张图像中定位该概念；随后遮蔽定位区域，通过比较原始图像与遮蔽图像在黑盒模型输出上的变化来度量归因。该方法直接测量模型行为，支持局部归因，且无需访问模型权重或标注概念数据集。
ai_summary.result: 在 CelebA 和 COCO-Stuff 上，HnS 与真实归因的一致性优于现有方法；并成功应用于图像描述和卫星图像分割等任务，而这些任务此前没有可用的概念归因方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次实现无需模型权重和概念标注数据的黑盒视觉模型概念级局部归因，借助视觉语言模型完成概念检索、定位与遮蔽来测量模型输出变化。
ai_summary.relevance: 扩展了概念归因方法的适用范围，使黑盒视觉模型在更广泛任务上可解释，有助于提升AI的可信性与可解释性。
ai_summary.org: Arizona State University（根据作者信息推断）

papers.title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
papers.abstract: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.

ai_summary.problem: 漫画是20世纪重要的视觉记录，但海量档案从未被整体研究，传统漫画研究通常一次只分析一本书。论文试图用人工智能实现大规模漫画档案的系统性研究，并帮助保存、检索和传播漫画媒介。
ai_summary.method: 提出PAGE框架，将AI作为漫画研究工具：把扫描页解析为分镜、文本和书目记录；用视觉-语言模型按书面编码手册逐页标注；用人工标注校准部分样本；并在控制出版商和体裁后解释档案中的变化。基于该框架开展三项研究，覆盖1938—1956年的3929本美国漫画和87卷日本漫画。
ai_summary.result: 三项研究分别结合文本搜索与视觉阅读分析政治权力 portrayal、测量整个行业的页面视觉形式并识别艺术家风格、追踪两种漫画传统中的说话者并与人工标注校验。框架还可让档案按绘画内容检索，服务盲人和低视力读者，并辅助保存脆弱藏品和认定未署名艺术家。
ai_summary.novelty: 将视觉-语言模型、生成模型与人类编码手册和标注校准结合，形成可大规模分析漫画档案的PAGE框架，并在美国漫画和日本漫画上做多任务实证。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多模态大模型在数字人文和文化档案大规模分析中的应用潜力，推动AI与人类标注协作的研究范式。

papers.title: SeoulMMOD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Origin-Destination Flow Benchmark
papers.abstract: Origin-destination (OD) flow forecasting supports urban mobility decisions by predicting the volume and patterns of human movement across a city. Most existing public OD benchmarks provide only a partial view of citywide mobility, covering a single transport service or at most two modes. With partial mode coverage, observed demand changes are difficult to separate into shifts across transport modes and changes in total travel. We introduce SeoulMMOD, a large-scale public benchmark for citywide multimodal mobility in Seoul. SeoulMMOD provides three years of hourly OD flows estimating total mobility for 6 urban travel modes across 25 districts and 426 sub-districts, together with travel-time, travel-distance, calendar, rainfall, and point-of-interest (POI) signals. Using SeoulMMOD, we benchmark 14 forecasting baselines under a common protocol and analyse the effects of spatial scaling, joint versus mode-separate training, and cross-year generalization. Results show that several spatio-temporal models that work at district level do not scale to sub-district OD forecasting, and that naive joint multi-mode training does not consistently improve accuracy. Together, the dataset and benchmark establish a reproducible testbed for multi-mode, multi-year OD forecasting at the city scale.

ai_summary.problem: 现有城市OD流预测基准通常只覆盖单一或至多两种交通方式，难以区分出行方式转移与总出行需求变化，尤其缺乏全市多模式、多年份的公开数据。
ai_summary.method: 构建 SeoulMMOD 大规模公开基准，提供首尔3年逐小时、6种城市出行方式、25个区与426个子区尺度的OD流量，并附带旅行时间、距离、日历、降雨和POI等信号。在统一协议下评测14个预测基线，分析空间尺度、联合多模式训练与跨年泛化等影响。
ai_summary.result: 实验显示，一些在区级有效的时空模型无法扩展到子区级OD预测，且简单的多模式联合训练并不总能提升精度。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了覆盖全市、多交通方式、多年份且含丰富外部信号的大规模多模态OD流公开基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为城市时空预测、多模态出行建模和可复现基准评测提供了重要测试平台。

papers.title: AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. Instead of discarding encoder structure after the encoding stage, AudioTETRIS propagates this prior directly into the LLM decoder to compute a per-token fused score. This score drives progressive top-$k$ token selection across decoder layers without requiring additional training or auxiliary models. Evaluated on Qwen2-Audio-7B, Phi-4-Multimodal, and Audio Flamingo 3, AudioTETRIS retains near-uncompressed performance on several speech tasks using only 25% of audio tokens, matches or surpasses full-token accuracy at moderate compression rates, and consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）的音频编码器即使对短音频也会产生数百个 token，自注意力随序列长度平方增长导致推理算力开销巨大；而现有免训练压缩方法仅依据粗粒度注意力或特征相似度剪枝/合并 token，把音频 token 当作各向同性的通用特征，抹平了频谱过渡，破坏了语音解码所依赖的细粒度音素过渡信息。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AudioTETRIS，一个免训练的两阶段框架：先利用音频编码器的表示几何（representation geometry）作为声学先验来刻画 token 重要性，再将这一先验从编码阶段传递到 LLM 解码器，计算逐 token 的融合分数；该分数驱动解码器各层进行渐进式 top-k token 选择，无需额外训练或辅助模型。
ai_summary.result: 在 Qwen2-Audio-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal 和 Audio Flamingo 3 上评测，仅保留 25% 音频 token 即可在多项语音任务上接近未压缩性能，在中等压缩率下匹配甚至超越全 token 准确率，并持续优于现有免训练基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次把音频编码器的表示几何结构作为声学先验直接传播到 LLM 解码器，以融合重要性分数驱动渐进式 token 选择，实现面向语音过渡结构的高效免训练压缩。
ai_summary.relevance: 为音频/多模态大模型的推理效率提供了无需训练、即插即用的 token 压缩思路，凸显了将模态自身的结构化先验引入解码过程的价值，可推广到其他长序列多模态场景。

papers.title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
papers.abstract: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.

papers.title: When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate's own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.

papers.title: HorizonNav: Geometry-Guided Video Diffusion for Anticipatory 3D Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: We present HorizonNav, a video diffusion-based framework for anticipatory robot navigation that transforms a single RGB image and a text prompt into a geometrically aligned representation of plausible surrounding 3D space. Given the initial observation and a textual description of the reconstruction objective, a vision-language model, guided by designed instructions, interprets the scene and constructs structured prompts for a video diffusion model. The resulting video sequence provides plausible future observations of the environment, which are subsequently processed using monocular ORB-SLAM3 for camera pose estimation and Video Depth Anything for dense depth prediction. Our central contribution is a geometry-guided depth alignment stage that combines the estimated camera poses with triangulated visual landmarks to constrain dense depth predictions across multiple views. This alignment improves the geometric consistency of the reconstructed 3D environment, addressing inconsistencies that temporal coherence of the generated video alone cannot resolve. The experimental evaluation of navigation in imagined 3D environment shows that across a 19-scene horizon study, planning-feasible scenes increase from 13/19 at P20 to 15/19 at P81, while successful RRT trials increase from 62/90 to 75/90. In a separate corridor study, 6 of 25 evaluable generated-camera trajectories violate the reconstructed collision constraints; RRT planner recovers feasible alternatives in 5 of those 6 cases. A larger archive contains 58 usable reconstructions from 67 attempted cases, of which 36 support a downstream plan and 22 do not, exposing reconstruction and free-space failure modes rather than hiding them without lidar. Across 15 corridor reconstructions, the mean reconstruction error is approximately 0.30 m at matched structural landmarks.

papers.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $π_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $π_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

papers.title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
papers.abstract: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

papers.title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
papers.abstract: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

papers.title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
papers.abstract: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE

papers.title: JitterVLA: A Replay Benchmark for Motion Quality in VLA-Driven Human-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller's effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.

papers.title: Can Multimodal Decision Models Classify Breast Ultrasound Images? Benchmarking CLEF and CLEF-Flash Across Prompts and Datasets
papers.abstract: Multimodal decision models return probabilities over predefined alternatives, offering a structured interface for image classification. This study benchmarks inference with CLEF and CLEF-Flash on 2818 breast ultrasound images from Dataset B, BUSI, and BUS-BRA. Dataset B and BUS-BRA use binary benign-malignant classification, whereas BUSI includes normal, benign, and malignant categories. Model parameters remain unchanged, and original images are submitted without user-defined preprocessing. Three prompts provide minimal labels, an explicit classification task, or sonographic criteria. We report accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, macro precision, throughput, and latency. CLEF-Flash with the clinical prompt achieves the highest accuracy on all three datasets: 74.85% on Dataset B, 66.28% on BUSI, and 51.63% on BUS-BRA. On BUSI, however, CLEF with the task-guided prompt achieves the highest macro F1 (64.51%) and balanced accuracy (68.72%). CLEF-Flash has lower latency in every matched comparison. Clinical instructions improve CLEF-Flash accuracy relative to the minimal prompt but reduce CLEF accuracy on all datasets. Confusion matrices reveal frequent benign-to-malignant errors, particularly on BUS-BRA, where all configurations fall below the 67.63% accuracy of a majority-class predictor. These findings demonstrate dataset-and prompt-dependent performance and motivate class-specific evaluation before applying multimodal decision models to breast ultrasound analysis.
